$comment: OSV-Scanner findings accepted with an owner and an expiry. Enforced by scripts/check-osv.mjs, which FAILS on any finding without an unexpired entry. Production-reachable findings must use scope:production and name the packages.

exceptions.summary: Undici has an HTTP Request/Response Smuggling issue
exceptions.reason: Dev/build-only dependency: not reachable from the production bundle (`npm ls --omit=dev` does not contain it), so it never reaches a browser or the deployed Worker. Exploitation requires local access to a developer machine or CI runner. Tracked for upgrade; dependency bumps are held until Phase 1 completes so the delivery pipeline is trustworthy before the tree moves.

exceptions.summary: nanoid: custom generators can loop indefinitely when size is zero
exceptions.reason: Dev/build-only: nanoid 3.3.16 is reached solely via vite -> postcss and is NOT in the production tree (`npm ls --omit=dev` has 99 packages and nanoid is not among them), so it never ships to a browser or the deployed Worker. The advisory needs a CUSTOM generator invoked with size zero; this repo never calls nanoid at all, let alone with a custom alphabet, and postcss uses it internally with fixed sizes. Resolves when vite/postcss bump the transitive pin; dependency bumps are batched and reviewed per-family rather than taken ad hoc.
